claims.exactBehavior: Physical-storage service review exposes clear deleted files record with exact two-stage questions and distinct yes/no labels. First yes only advances; either decline or owner close preserves records. Final yes clears non-trash local deletion records and reasons through the existing content writer, preserves trash history/import timestamps and queued physical deletions, refreshes review counts and survives reopen. The import-status consumer sees permanently deleted become unknown while trash remains deleted. Selection and alternate requests cannot replace a live captured service/action; retired callbacks do not write.

referenceRecording.result: Passed actual Qt first decline / second decline / both accepted. Live content-update writes, local domain counts and file import hash status captured on a freshly unpacked temporary basic fixture. Async scheduling made synchronous; exact GetYesNo messages/labels/decisions recorded. Reference panel PNG inspected.

limitations: Service review parent remains partial; native dropdown and inline staged questions replace Qt notebook/two modal dialogs.
The existing physical-delete worker is unchanged; clearing records neither unlinks bytes nor cancels queued deletes.
No remote/IPFS/listener/account scope; no additional aliases or parent promotions.
Rust regressions authored for root hosted CI; no local Cargo build, test or mutation test.
